title: Laashe Pe Naujawan
body:
laash akbar ki jo maqtal se utha laaye hussain
ek kohraam tha qaime mein jo maula ne kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe pe naujawan ke chadar udhao zainab
akbar ka zakhmi seena maa se chupao zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
beenayi bhi nahi hai khat kis tarha padhunga
mai us se kya kahunga
qasid hai aane waala is ko jagao zainab
laashe pe naujawan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ka gham uthana aasaan nahi hai bibi
jee bhar ke ro le wo bhi
qaime mein naujawan ki behnein bulao zainab
laashe pe naujawan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kar lo behan tasavvur armaan kuch to niklein
hum sehra pad rahe hai
tum apne naujawan ko dulha banao zainab
laashe pe naujawan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kurta lahoo mein tar hai mil jayega kafan bhi
khwahish bhi hogi poori
akbar ki shadi waali poshak lao zainab
laashe pe naujawan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
shayad isi tarha se dil ko qaraar aaye
beenayi laut jaaye
aankhon se naujawan ka kurta lagao zainab
laashe pe naujawan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhse zyada tum se nazdeek ye raha hai
tum ko to sab pata hai
akbar ke bachpane ki baatein sunao zainab
laashe pe naujawan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
laila ka haal ajab hai jab se khabar hai aayi
deta nahi dikhayi
baazu pakad ke maa ka laashe pe lao zainab
laashe pe naujawan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha liye takallum qaime se sheh jo nikle
ro kar behan se bole
rukhsat yahin se kar do baahir na aao zainab
laashe pe naujawan ke...
author: Mir Takallum
